column1: # Panel crash: penjelasan sumber crash dan bantuan AI
Aplikasi tertutup karena kesalahan tak terduga
Crash tidak selalu berarti launcher-nya rusak. Mod, RAM HP, dan driver grafis jauh lebih sering menjadi penyebabnya, jadi cari tahu dulu sebelum melapor ke pengembang.
column2: Crash kh\u00f4ng ph\u1ea3i l\u00fac n\u00e0o c\u0169ng c\u00f3 ngh\u0129a l\u00e0 launcher b\u1ecb h\u1ecfng. Mod, RAM c\u1ee7a \u0111i\u1ec7n tho\u1ea1i v\u00e0 tr\u00ecnh \u0111i\u1ec1u khi\u1ec3n \u0111\u1ed3 h\u1ecda th\u01b0\u1eddng l\u00e0 nguy\u00ean nh\u00e2n h\u01a1n nhi\u1ec1u, n\u00ean h\u00e3y t\u00ecm hi\u1ec3u tr\u01b0\u1edbc khi b\u00e1o cho nh\u00e0 ph\u00e1t tri\u1ec3n.

column1: Launcher berhenti mendadak karena kesalahan tak terduga. Kirim log-nya ke pengembang supaya bisa diperbaiki.
column2: Launcher d\u1eebng \u0111\u1ed9t ng\u1ed9t do l\u1ed7i b\u1ea5t ng\u1edd. H\u00e3y g\u1eedi nh\u1eadt k\u00fd cho nh\u00e0 ph\u00e1t tri\u1ec3n \u0111\u1ec3 h\u1ecd s\u1eeda l\u1ed7i.
Tr\u00ecnh k\u1ebft xu\u1ea5t ho\u1eb7c tr\u00ecnh \u0111i\u1ec1u khi\u1ec3n \u0111\u1ed3 h\u1ecda

column1: Mod, versi Java, atau file game
column2: M\u1ed9t mod, phi\u00ean b\u1ea3n Java ho\u1eb7c t\u1ec7p game

column1: Kali ini launcher sendiri yang berhenti, bukan game atau mod. Laporan ke pengembang sangat membantu supaya bisa diperbaiki.
column2: L\u1ea7n n\u00e0y ch\u00ednh launcher \u0111\u00e3 d\u1eebng, kh\u00f4ng ph\u1ea3i game hay mod. B\u00e1o cho nh\u00e0 ph\u00e1t tri\u1ec3n s\u1ebd gi\u00fap s\u1eeda l\u1ed7i.

column1: Game dihentikan sistem karena RAM HP tidak cukup untuk game, mod, atau pengaturan grafis yang dipakai. Biasanya bukan kerusakan launcher. Coba kurangi alokasi RAM game (jangan lebih dari setengah RAM HP), kurangi mod, dan tutup aplikasi lain.
column2: H\u1ec7 th\u1ed1ng \u0111\u00e3 d\u1eebng game v\u00ec \u0111i\u1ec7n tho\u1ea1i kh\u00f4ng \u0111\u1ee7 RAM cho game, mod ho\u1eb7c c\u00e0i \u0111\u1eb7t \u0111\u1ed3 h\u1ecda \u0111ang d\u00f9ng. Th\u01b0\u1eddng \u0111\u00e2y kh\u00f4ng ph\u1ea3i l\u1ed7i c\u1ee7a launcher. H\u00e3y th\u1eed gi\u1ea3m RAM c\u1ea5p cho game (kh\u00f4ng qu\u00e1 m\u1ed9t n\u1eeda RAM \u0111i\u1ec7n tho\u1ea1i), b\u1edbt mod v\u00e0 \u0111\u00f3ng c\u00e1c \u1ee9ng d\u1ee5ng kh\u00e1c.

column1: Game berhenti di bagian grafis atau pustaka bawaan HP. Penyebab umumnya renderer yang kurang cocok dengan HP ini. Coba ganti renderer di pengaturan instance. Kalau semua renderer gagal, barulah mungkin masalahnya ada di launcher.
column2: Game d\u1eebng \u1edf ph\u1ea7n \u0111\u1ed3 h\u1ecda ho\u1eb7c th\u01b0 vi\u1ec7n c\u00f3 s\u1eb5n c\u1ee7a \u0111i\u1ec7n tho\u1ea1i. Nguy\u00ean nh\u00e2n th\u01b0\u1eddng g\u1eb7p l\u00e0 tr\u00ecnh k\u1ebft xu\u1ea5t kh\u00f4ng h\u1ee3p v\u1edbi \u0111i\u1ec7n tho\u1ea1i n\u00e0y. H\u00e3y th\u1eed \u0111\u1ed5i tr\u00ecnh k\u1ebft xu\u1ea5t trong c\u00e0i \u0111\u1eb7t instance. Ch\u1ec9 khi m\u1ecdi tr\u00ecnh k\u1ebft xu\u1ea5t \u0111\u1ec1u l\u1ed7i th\u00ec v\u1ea5n \u0111\u1ec1 m\u1edbi c\u00f3 th\u1ec3 n\u1eb1m \u1edf launcher.

column1: Game mengalami error saat berjalan. Paling sering karena mod yang tidak cocok dengan versi game atau loader, mod yang kekurangan pendukung (dependency), atau versi Java yang tidak sesuai. Biasanya bukan kerusakan launcher.
column2: Game g\u1eb7p l\u1ed7i khi \u0111ang ch\u1ea1y. Th\u01b0\u1eddng l\u00e0 do mod kh\u00f4ng kh\u1edbp v\u1edbi phi\u00ean b\u1ea3n game ho\u1eb7c loader, mod thi\u1ebfu th\u01b0 vi\u1ec7n ph\u1ee5 thu\u1ed9c, ho\u1eb7c phi\u00ean b\u1ea3n Java kh\u00f4ng ph\u00f9 h\u1ee3p. Th\u01b0\u1eddng \u0111\u00e2y kh\u00f4ng ph\u1ea3i l\u1ed7i c\u1ee7a launcher.

column1: Penyebabnya baru kelihatan dari isi log. AI bisa membantu membacanya untukmu.
column2: Nguy\u00ean nh\u00e2n ch\u1ec9 l\u1ed9 ra trong n\u1ed9i dung nh\u1eadt k\u00fd. AI c\u00f3 th\u1ec3 gi\u00fap b\u1ea1n \u0111\u1ecdc n\u00f3.

column1: Kesalahan tak terduga di dalam aplikasi
column2: L\u1ed7i b\u1ea5t ng\u1edd b\u00ean trong \u1ee9ng d\u1ee5ng

column1: Salin log beserta pertanyaannya, lalu tempel di chat AI. Biasanya AI bisa menunjukkan penyebab dan cara memperbaikinya. Kirim teks log, bukan screenshot.
column2: Sao ch\u00e9p nh\u1eadt k\u00fd k\u00e8m c\u00e2u h\u1ecfi so\u1ea1n s\u1eb5n r\u1ed3i d\u00e1n v\u00e0o khung chat c\u1ee7a AI. AI th\u01b0\u1eddng ch\u1ec9 ra \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c nguy\u00ean nh\u00e2n v\u00e0 c\u00e1ch s\u1eeda. H\u00e3y g\u1eedi v\u0103n b\u1ea3n nh\u1eadt k\u00fd, \u0111\u1eebng g\u1eedi \u1ea3nh ch\u1ee5p m\u00e0n h\u00ecnh.
Sao ch\u00e9p nh\u1eadt k\u00fd cho AI
Ho\u1eb7c m\u1edf tr\u1ef1c ti\u1ebfp (nh\u1eadt k\u00fd t\u1ef1 \u0111\u1ed9ng \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c sao ch\u00e9p)

column1: Kalau AI menyimpulkan masalahnya ada di launcher, baru laporkan di GitHub. Log disalin otomatis, tinggal tempel di laporan.
column2: N\u1ebfu AI k\u1ebft lu\u1eadn v\u1ea5n \u0111\u1ec1 n\u1eb1m \u1edf launcher, h\u00e3y b\u00e1o tr\u00ean GitHub. Nh\u1eadt k\u00fd \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c sao ch\u00e9p t\u1ef1 \u0111\u1ed9ng, ch\u1ec9 c\u1ea7n d\u00e1n v\u00e0o b\u00e1o c\u00e1o.

column1: Laporkan di GitHub supaya bisa diperbaiki. Log disalin otomatis, tinggal tempel di laporan.
column2: H\u00e3y b\u00e1o tr\u00ean GitHub \u0111\u1ec3 l\u1ed7i \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c s\u1eeda. Nh\u1eadt k\u00fd \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c sao ch\u00e9p t\u1ef1 \u0111\u1ed9ng, ch\u1ec9 c\u1ea7n d\u00e1n v\u00e0o b\u00e1o c\u00e1o.
C\u00e1ch kh\u00e1c \u0111\u1ec3 chia s\u1ebb nh\u1eadt k\u00fd

column1: Log untuk AI disalin. Tempel di kolom chat AI.
column2: \u0110\u00e3 sao ch\u00e9p nh\u1eadt k\u00fd cho AI. H\u00e3y d\u00e1n v\u00e0o khung chat c\u1ee7a AI.
\u0110\u00e3 sao ch\u00e9p nh\u1eadt k\u00fd. H\u00e3y d\u00e1n v\u00e0o b\u00e1o c\u00e1o.

column1: Halo, Minecraft Java Edition saya crash di HP Android saat dijalankan lewat NovaCraft. Tolong jelaskan penyebabnya dengan bahasa sederhana (saya masih pemula), lalu beri langkah perbaikan satu per satu. Kalau penyebabnya mod, sebutkan mod mana yang perlu dihapus atau diganti.
column2: Xin ch\u00e0o, Minecraft Java Edition c\u1ee7a t\u00f4i b\u1ecb crash tr\u00ean \u0111i\u1ec7n tho\u1ea1i Android khi ch\u1ea1y b\u1eb1ng NovaCraft. H\u00e3y gi\u1ea3i th\u00edch nguy\u00ean nh\u00e2n b\u1eb1ng ng\u00f4n ng\u1eef \u0111\u01a1n gi\u1ea3n (t\u00f4i l\u00e0 ng\u01b0\u1eddi m\u1edbi) r\u1ed3i h\u01b0\u1edbng d\u1eabn c\u00e1ch s\u1eeda t\u1eebng b\u01b0\u1edbc. N\u1ebfu nguy\u00ean nh\u00e2n l\u00e0 mod, h\u00e3y cho t\u00f4i bi\u1ebft n\u00ean x\u00f3a ho\u1eb7c thay mod n\u00e0o.

column1: Halo, aplikasi NovaCraft (launcher Minecraft Java Edition untuk Android) berhenti sendiri. Tolong jelaskan penyebabnya dengan bahasa sederhana (saya masih pemula) dan beri saran yang bisa saya coba. Kalau menurutmu ini bug di launcher, tolong katakan.
column2: Xin ch\u00e0o, \u1ee9ng d\u1ee5ng NovaCraft (launcher Minecraft Java Edition cho Android) t\u1ef1 d\u1eebng. H\u00e3y gi\u1ea3i th\u00edch nguy\u00ean nh\u00e2n b\u1eb1ng ng\u00f4n ng\u1eef \u0111\u01a1n gi\u1ea3n (t\u00f4i l\u00e0 ng\u01b0\u1eddi m\u1edbi) v\u00e0 g\u1ee3i \u00fd nh\u1eefng g\u00ec t\u00f4i c\u00f3 th\u1ec3 th\u1eed. N\u1ebfu b\u1ea1n cho r\u1eb1ng \u0111\u00e2y l\u00e0 l\u1ed7i c\u1ee7a launcher, h\u00e3y n\u00f3i r\u00f5.

column1: Memberi ruang lebih bagi HP. Bisa dinaikkan lagi di Pengaturan > Memori.
column2: Gi\u00fap \u0111i\u1ec7n tho\u1ea1i c\u00f3 th\u00eam ch\u1ed7 tr\u1ed1ng. B\u1ea1n c\u00f3 th\u1ec3 t\u0103ng l\u1ea1i trong C\u00e0i \u0111\u1eb7t > B\u1ed9 nh\u1edb.

column1: # Buat Instance: peringatan Minecraft 26.x ke atas dan pengecekan Vulkan HP

column2: H\u1ec7 s\u1ed1 nh\u00e2n th\u00eam v\u00e0o \u0111\u1ed9 nh\u1ea1y camera, ch\u1ec9 \u00e1p d\u1ee5ng cho chu\u1ed9t th\u1eadt khi \u0111ang ch\u01a1i. 100% = gi\u1eef nguy\u00ean.

column1: Hotspot adalah titik yang dihitung sebagai ujung kursor saat mengklik (titik merah di pratinjau).
column2: Hotspot l\u00e0 \u0111i\u1ec3m \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c t\u00ednh l\u00e0 \u0111\u1ea7u con tr\u1ecf khi nh\u1ea5p (ch\u1ea5m \u0111\u1ecf trong ph\u1ea7n xem tr\u01b0\u1edbc).

column1: Kunci sudah tersimpan. Isi kunci baru untuk menggantinya, atau hapus kunci ini.
column2: \u0110\u00e3 l\u01b0u kh\u00f3a. Nh\u1eadp kh\u00f3a m\u1edbi \u0111\u1ec3 thay th\u1ebf, ho\u1eb7c x\u00f3a kh\u00f3a n\u00e0y.

column1: CurseForge butuh kunci API. Tempel kunci dari email CurseForge. Kunci hanya disimpan di HP ini dan hanya dikirim ke CurseForge.
column2: CurseForge c\u1ea7n kh\u00f3a API. D\u00e1n kh\u00f3a t\u1eeb email c\u1ee7a CurseForge. Kh\u00f3a ch\u1ec9 \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c l\u01b0u tr\u00ean \u0111i\u1ec7n tho\u1ea1i n\u00e0y v\u00e0 ch\u1ec9 \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c g\u1eedi \u0111\u1ebfn CurseForge.

column1: Kunci API CurseForge ditolak (kode {0}). Periksa kuncinya lalu isi ulang.
column2: Kh\u00f3a API CurseForge b\u1ecb t\u1eeb ch\u1ed1i (m\u00e3 {0}). H\u00e3y ki\u1ec3m tra kh\u00f3a r\u1ed3i nh\u1eadp l\u1ea1i.

column1: CurseForge membatasi permintaan. Tunggu sebentar lalu coba lagi.
column2: CurseForge \u0111ang gi\u1edbi h\u1ea1n s\u1ed1 y\u00eau c\u1ea7u. H\u00e3y ch\u1edd m\u1ed9t l\u00e1t r\u1ed3i th\u1eed l\u1ea1i.
Kh\u00f4ng nh\u1eadn d\u1ea1ng \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c ph\u1ea3n h\u1ed3i c\u1ee7a CurseForge

column1: CurseForge hanya menampilkan {0} hasil pertama. Persempit pencarian.
column2: CurseForge ch\u1ec9 hi\u1ec3n th\u1ecb {0} k\u1ebft qu\u1ea3 \u0111\u1ea7u ti\u00ean. H\u00e3y thu h\u1eb9p t\u00ecm ki\u1ebfm.

column1: Penulis melarang unduhan lewat launcher. Unduh manual dari situs CurseForge.
column2: T\u00e1c gi\u1ea3 kh\u00f4ng cho ph\u00e9p t\u1ea3i qua launcher. H\u00e3y t\u1ea3i th\u1ee7 c\u00f4ng t\u1eeb trang web CurseForge.

column1: Mencari alamat unduhan mod dari CurseForge...
column2: \u0110ang t\u00ecm \u0111\u1ecba ch\u1ec9 t\u1ea3i mod t\u1eeb CurseForge...

column1: Mesin Rust baru mendukung akun Offline dan Microsoft. Pilih salah satunya di tab Akun.
column2: Engine Rust hi\u1ec7n m\u1edbi h\u1ed7 tr\u1ee3 t\u00e0i kho\u1ea3n Offline v\u00e0 Microsoft. H\u00e3y ch\u1ecdn m\u1ed9t trong hai \u1edf tab T\u00e0i kho\u1ea3n.

column1: Nama akun offline untuk mesin Rust harus 1 sampai 16 karakter tanpa spasi. Buat akun offline baru di tab Akun.
column2: T\u00ean t\u00e0i kho\u1ea3n offline cho engine Rust ph\u1ea3i d\u00e0i t\u1eeb 1 \u0111\u1ebfn 16 k\u00fd t\u1ef1 v\u00e0 kh\u00f4ng c\u00f3 kho\u1ea3ng tr\u1eafng. H\u00e3y t\u1ea1o t\u00e0i kho\u1ea3n offline m\u1edbi \u1edf tab T\u00e0i kho\u1ea3n.

column1: Akun Microsoft ini belum login lengkap. Masuk lagi lewat tab Akun.
column2: T\u00e0i kho\u1ea3n Microsoft n\u00e0y ch\u01b0a \u0111\u0103ng nh\u1eadp \u0111\u1ea7y \u0111\u1ee7. H\u00e3y \u0111\u0103ng nh\u1eadp l\u1ea1i \u1edf tab T\u00e0i kho\u1ea3n.

column1: Pertama kali dibuka: mesin mengunduh sumber daya game (sekitar 500 MiB). Biarkan sampai selesai, game langsung dimulai setelahnya.
column2: L\u1ea7n m\u1edf \u0111\u1ea7u ti\u00ean: engine s\u1ebd t\u1ea3i t\u00e0i nguy\u00ean game (kho\u1ea3ng 500 MiB). H\u00e3y \u0111\u1ec3 n\u00f3 ch\u1ea1y xong, game s\u1ebd b\u1eaft \u0111\u1ea7u ngay sau \u0111\u00f3.

column1: Folder data mesin tidak bisa dibuat
column2: Kh\u00f4ng t\u1ea1o \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c th\u01b0 m\u1ee5c d\u1eef li\u1ec7u c\u1ee7a engine

column1: Menyembunyikan bilah navigasi dan bilah status saat bermain. Mati secara bawaan: di sebagian HP bisa membuat game macet.
column2: \u1ea8n thanh \u0111i\u1ec1u h\u01b0\u1edbng v\u00e0 thanh tr\u1ea1ng th\u00e1i khi ch\u01a1i. M\u1eb7c \u0111\u1ecbnh t\u1eaft: tr\u00ean m\u1ed9t s\u1ed1 \u0111i\u1ec7n tho\u1ea1i c\u00f3 th\u1ec3 khi\u1ebfn game b\u1ecb treo.

column1: Tidak ada versi Forge yang didukung
column2: Kh\u00f4ng c\u00f3 phi\u00ean b\u1ea3n Forge n\u00e0o \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c h\u1ed7 tr\u1ee3

column1: Tidak ada versi NeoForge yang didukung
column2: Kh\u00f4ng c\u00f3 phi\u00ean b\u1ea3n NeoForge n\u00e0o \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c h\u1ed7 tr\u1ee3

column1: Tidak dapat memuat daftar versi Fabric
column2: Kh\u00f4ng t\u1ea3i \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c danh s\u00e1ch phi\u00ean b\u1ea3n Fabric

column1: Ruang penyimpanan tinggal {0} MB. Kosongkan minimal 500 MB lalu coba unduh lagi.
column2: Dung l\u01b0\u1ee3ng l\u01b0u tr\u1eef ch\u1ec9 c\u00f2n {0} MB. H\u00e3y gi\u1ea3i ph\u00f3ng \u00edt nh\u1ea5t 500 MB r\u1ed3i t\u1ea3i l\u1ea1i.

column1: Unduhan lanjut di latar belakang. Jangan tutup paksa aplikasi.
column2: Qu\u00e1 tr\u00ecnh t\u1ea3i ti\u1ebfp t\u1ee5c \u1edf n\u1ec1n. \u0110\u1eebng bu\u1ed9c d\u1eebng \u1ee9ng d\u1ee5ng.

column1: Menyalakan mode performa stabil sistem dan V-Sync Zink, serta membatasi skala resolusi maksimal {0}%.
column2: B\u1eadt ch\u1ebf \u0111\u1ed9 hi\u1ec7u n\u0103ng \u1ed5n \u0111\u1ecbnh c\u1ee7a h\u1ec7 th\u1ed1ng v\u00e0 V-Sync c\u1ee7a Zink, \u0111\u1ed3ng th\u1eddi gi\u1edbi h\u1ea1n t\u1ef7 l\u1ec7 \u0111\u1ed9 ph\u00e2n gi\u1ea3i t\u1ed1i \u0111a \u1edf {0}%.

column1: Pengganti seluruh client Java: tanpa JVM dan tanpa mod Java.
column2: Thay th\u1ebf to\u00e0n b\u1ed9 client Java: kh\u00f4ng c\u00f3 JVM v\u00e0 kh\u00f4ng d\u00f9ng mod Java.

column1: Diunduh otomatis saat PLAY pertama, sekitar 500 MiB.
column2: T\u1ef1 t\u1ea3i \u1edf l\u1ea7n PLAY \u0111\u1ea7u ti\u00ean, kho\u1ea3ng 500 MiB.

column1: Satu-satunya versi yang dikerjakan mesin ini.
column2: Phi\u00ean b\u1ea3n duy nh\u1ea5t engine n\u00e0y h\u1ed7 tr\u1ee3.

column1: Pilihan di tab ini dipakai instance Rust saja dan berlaku pada PLAY berikutnya. Instance Vanilla, Fabric, dan Forge tidak terpengaruh.
column2: C\u00e1c l\u1ef1a ch\u1ecdn \u1edf tab n\u00e0y ch\u1ec9 d\u00f9ng cho instance Rust v\u00e0 c\u00f3 hi\u1ec7u l\u1ef1c \u1edf l\u1ea7n PLAY ti\u1ebfp theo. Instance Vanilla, Fabric v\u00e0 Forge kh\u00f4ng b\u1ecb \u1ea3nh h\u01b0\u1edfng.

column1: Kompatibel paling aman untuk semua HP. Vulkan cepat memakai batching GPU. OpenGL ES masih eksperimental.
column2: T\u01b0\u01a1ng th\u00edch l\u00e0 an to\u00e0n nh\u1ea5t tr\u00ean m\u1ecdi \u0111i\u1ec7n tho\u1ea1i. Vulkan nhanh d\u00f9ng batching GPU. OpenGL ES v\u1eabn \u0111ang th\u1eed nghi\u1ec7m.

column1: Menurunkan resolusi render membuat game lebih ringan, gambar jadi lebih buram.
column2: Gi\u1ea3m \u0111\u1ed9 ph\u00e2n gi\u1ea3i render gi\u00fap game nh\u1eb9 h\u01a1n nh\u01b0ng h\u00ecnh \u1ea3nh s\u1ebd m\u1edd h\u01a1n.

column1: Permintaan ke Android, bukan batas FPS game. Laju yang tidak didukung layar bisa diabaikan.
column2: \u0110\u00e2y l\u00e0 y\u00eau c\u1ea7u g\u1eedi Android, kh\u00f4ng ph\u1ea3i gi\u1edbi h\u1ea1n FPS. T\u1ea7n s\u1ed1 m\u00e0 m\u00e0n h\u00ecnh kh\u00f4ng h\u1ed7 tr\u1ee3 c\u00f3 th\u1ec3 b\u1ecb b\u1ecf qua.

column1: Memberi tahu Android bahwa game butuh performa stabil. Hanya berguna di HP yang mendukungnya.
column2: B\u00e1o cho Android bi\u1ebft game c\u1ea7n hi\u1ec7u n\u0103ng \u1ed5n \u0111\u1ecbnh. Ch\u1ec9 c\u00f3 \u00edch tr\u00ean \u0111i\u1ec7n tho\u1ea1i h\u1ed7 tr\u1ee3.

column1: Batas pekerja yang membuat dan merakit chunk, bukan semua utas aplikasi. Nilai kecil mengurangi beban CPU tetapi memuat dunia lebih lambat.
column2: Gi\u1edbi h\u1ea1n s\u1ed1 worker t\u1ea1o v\u00e0 gh\u00e9p chunk, kh\u00f4ng ph\u1ea3i m\u1ecdi lu\u1ed3ng c\u1ee7a \u1ee9ng d\u1ee5ng. Gi\u00e1 tr\u1ecb nh\u1ecf gi\u1ea3m t\u1ea3i CPU nh\u01b0ng t\u1ea3i th\u1ebf gi\u1edbi ch\u1eadm h\u01a1n.

column1: Suara yang sudah didekode (80%) dan buffer mesh kosong (20%), dibuat ulang dengan kualitas sama. Bukan batas total RAM atau VRAM. Nilai kecil bisa menambah kerja CPU.
column2: \u00c2m thanh \u0111\u00e3 gi\u1ea3i m\u00e3 (80%) v\u00e0 b\u1ed9 \u0111\u1ec7m mesh tr\u1ed1ng (20%), \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c t\u1ea1o l\u1ea1i v\u1edbi c\u00f9ng ch\u1ea5t l\u01b0\u1ee3ng. Kh\u00f4ng ph\u1ea3i gi\u1edbi h\u1ea1n t\u1ed5ng RAM hay VRAM. Gi\u00e1 tr\u1ecb nh\u1ecf c\u00f3 th\u1ec3 t\u0103ng vi\u1ec7c cho CPU.

column1: Arah layar saat bermain. Bawaannya landscape.
column2: H\u01b0\u1edbng m\u00e0n h\u00ecnh khi ch\u01a1i. M\u1eb7c \u0111\u1ecbnh l\u00e0 ngang.

column1: Membatasi tampilan game ke rasio tertentu. Asli mengikuti rasio layar HP.
column2: Gi\u1edbi h\u1ea1n khung nh\u00ecn game theo m\u1ed9t t\u1ec9 l\u1ec7. G\u1ed1c theo t\u1ec9 l\u1ec7 m\u00e0n h\u00ecnh c\u1ee7a \u0111i\u1ec7n tho\u1ea1i.

column1: Menyembunyikan bilah navigasi dan bilah status saat bermain.
column2: \u1ea8n thanh \u0111i\u1ec1u h\u01b0\u1edbng v\u00e0 thanh tr\u1ea1ng th\u00e1i khi ch\u01a1i.

column1: Menggeser tampilan game agar tidak tertutup lubang kamera atau poni.
column2: D\u1ecbch khung game \u0111\u1ec3 l\u1ed7 camera ho\u1eb7c tai th\u1ecf kh\u00f4ng che m\u1ea5t.

column1: Posisi, ukuran, dan tombol layar mengikuti editor kontrol NovaCraft, jadi hanya ada satu set kontrol. Matikan untuk memakai kontrol bawaan mesin. Berlaku di PLAY berikutnya.
column2: Các nút trên màn hình theo trình chỉnh điều khiển của NovaCraft (vị trí, kích thước và nút), nên chỉ có một bộ điều khiển. Tắt để dùng điều khiển của engine. Áp dụng ở lần PLAY tiếp theo.

column1: Otomatis memilih sendiri antara layar sentuh, keyboard dan mouse, atau gamepad sesuai yang terpasang.
column2: T\u1ef1 \u0111\u1ed9ng ch\u1ecdn gi\u1eefa c\u1ea3m \u1ee9ng, b\u00e0n ph\u00edm v\u00e0 chu\u1ed9t, ho\u1eb7c tay c\u1ea7m t\u00f9y thi\u1ebft b\u1ecb \u0111ang k\u1ebft n\u1ed1i.

column1: Kosongkan untuk bermain di dunia sendiri. Bila diisi, PLAY langsung masuk ke server ini.
column2: \u0110\u1ec3 tr\u1ed1ng \u0111\u1ec3 ch\u01a1i th\u1ebf gi\u1edbi ri\u00eang. N\u1ebfu \u0111i\u1ec1n, PLAY s\u1ebd v\u00e0o th\u1eb3ng m\u00e1y ch\u1ee7 n\u00e0y.

column1: Mengembalikan semua pilihan di tab ini ke bawaan mesin. Instance dan dunia tidak disentuh.
column2: \u0110\u01b0a m\u1ecdi l\u1ef1a ch\u1ecdn \u1edf tab n\u00e0y v\u1ec1 m\u1eb7c \u0111\u1ecbnh c\u1ee7a engine. Instance v\u00e0 th\u1ebf gi\u1edbi kh\u00f4ng b\u1ecb \u0111\u1ee5ng t\u1edbi.

column1: Normal memakai bawaan mesin. Super hemat menurunkan jarak render, partikel, awan, dan bayangan. Hemat baterai membatasi 60 FPS dengan VSync. FPS maksimum melepas batas FPS dan mematikan VSync. Mode ini mengubah pengaturan video game saat PLAY.
column2: B\u00ecnh th\u01b0\u1eddng d\u00f9ng m\u1eb7c \u0111\u1ecbnh c\u1ee7a engine. Si\u00eau ti\u1ebft ki\u1ec7m gi\u1ea3m t\u1ea7m render, h\u1ea1t, m\u00e2y v\u00e0 b\u00f3ng. Ti\u1ebft ki\u1ec7m pin gi\u1edbi h\u1ea1n 60 FPS v\u1edbi VSync. FPS t\u1ed1i \u0111a b\u1ecf gi\u1edbi h\u1ea1n FPS v\u00e0 t\u1eaft VSync. C\u00e1c ch\u1ebf \u0111\u1ed9 n\u00e0y thay \u0111\u1ed5i c\u00e0i \u0111\u1eb7t video c\u1ee7a game khi nh\u1ea5n PLAY.

column1: Mematikan tekstur beranimasi, fade chunk, goyangan kamera saat berjalan, dan blur menu. Lebih ringan di HP lemah.
column2: T\u1eaft texture ho\u1ea1t \u1ea3nh, hi\u1ec7u \u1ee9ng m\u1edd d\u1ea7n chunk, l\u1eafc camera khi \u0111i b\u1ed9 v\u00e0 l\u00e0m m\u1edd menu. Nh\u1eb9 h\u01a1n tr\u00ean m\u00e1y y\u1ebfu.

column1: Tombol bergaris tiga di layar game yang membuka menu cepat mesin (preset, kontrol, pengaturan). Warnanya mengikuti tema NovaCraft. Berlaku di PLAY berikutnya.
column2: Nút ba gạch trên màn hình game mở menu nhanh của engine (preset, điều khiển, cài đặt). Màu sắc theo giao diện NovaCraft. Áp dụng ở lần PLAY tiếp theo.

column1: Menyederhanakan dedaunan yang rapat agar lebih ringan. Tampilan daun berubah dan fitur ini masih eksperimental. Berlaku di PLAY berikutnya.
column2: \u0110\u01a1n gi\u1ea3n h\u00f3a t\u00e1n l\u00e1 d\u00e0y \u0111\u1eb7c \u0111\u1ec3 game nh\u1eb9 h\u01a1n. H\u00ecnh d\u1ea1ng l\u00e1 s\u1ebd thay \u0111\u1ed5i v\u00e0 t\u00ednh n\u0103ng n\u00e0y v\u1eabn \u0111ang th\u1eed nghi\u1ec7m. \u00c1p d\u1ee5ng \u1edf l\u1ea7n PLAY ti\u1ebfp theo.

column1: Menaikkan jatah unggah mesh chunk ke GPU menjadi 4 MiB per frame, dibuat untuk mengurangi tersendat saat bergerak dan memuat dunia. Menyala secara bawaan. Matikan bila game malah terasa patah-patah. Berlaku di PLAY berikutnya.
column2: N\u00e2ng h\u1ea1n m\u1ee9c t\u1ea3i mesh chunk l\u00ean GPU th\u00e0nh 4 MiB m\u1ed7i khung h\u00ecnh, nh\u1eb1m gi\u1ea3m gi\u1eadt khi di chuy\u1ec3n v\u00e0 t\u1ea3i th\u1ebf gi\u1edbi. M\u1eb7c \u0111\u1ecbnh b\u1eadt. H\u00e3y t\u1eaft n\u1ebfu game l\u1ea1i gi\u1eadt h\u01a1n. \u00c1p d\u1ee5ng \u1edf l\u1ea7n PLAY ti\u1ebfp theo.

column1: Merekam waktu frame dan pembuatan chunk saat bermain (sampai 30 menit) ke laporan di HP ini. Laporan tidak berisi akun, chat, atau nama dunia. Perekaman menambah sedikit beban, jadi matikan lagi bila tidak diperlukan. Berlaku di PLAY berikutnya.
column2: Ghi th\u1eddi gian khung h\u00ecnh v\u00e0 vi\u1ec7c t\u1ea1o chunk khi b\u1ea1n ch\u01a1i (t\u1ed1i \u0111a 30 ph\u00fat) v\u00e0o m\u1ed9t b\u00e1o c\u00e1o tr\u00ean \u0111i\u1ec7n tho\u1ea1i n\u00e0y. B\u00e1o c\u00e1o kh\u00f4ng ch\u1ee9a t\u00e0i kho\u1ea3n, chat hay t\u00ean th\u1ebf gi\u1edbi. Vi\u1ec7c ghi l\u00e0m t\u0103ng nh\u1eb9 t\u1ea3i, n\u00ean h\u00e3y t\u1eaft khi kh\u00f4ng c\u1ea7n. \u00c1p d\u1ee5ng \u1edf l\u1ea7n PLAY ti\u1ebfp theo.
Chia s\u1ebb b\u00e1o c\u00e1o hi\u1ec7u n\u0103ng

column1: Mengirim laporan rekaman terakhir lewat aplikasi pilihanmu, misalnya untuk dilampirkan saat melaporkan game yang lambat.
column2: G\u1eedi b\u00e1o c\u00e1o ghi g\u1ea7n nh\u1ea5t qua \u1ee9ng d\u1ee5ng b\u1ea1n ch\u1ecdn, v\u00ed d\u1ee5 \u0111\u1ec3 \u0111\u00ednh k\u00e8m khi b\u00e1o c\u00e1o game ch\u1ea1y ch\u1eadm.

column1: Belum ada laporan performa. Nyalakan Rekam performa, mainkan sebentar, lalu coba lagi.
column2: Chưa có báo cáo hiệu năng. Hãy bật Ghi hiệu năng, chơi một lúc rồi thử lại.

column1: Buka menu peluncur bawaan Horizon untuk mengelola profil, dunia, sumber daya, mod Horizon, atau masuk ke game dari dalam Horizon.
column2: Mở menu trình khởi chạy tích hợp sẵn của Horizon để quản lý hồ sơ, thế giới, tài nguyên, mod Horizon hoặc vào game từ bên trong Horizon.

column1: Masuk lewat UI Horizon saat PLAY
column2: Mở giao diện Horizon khi nhấn PLAY

column1: Saat menyala, tombol PLAY pada instance Rust akan membuka layar internal Horizon terlebih dahulu daripada langsung masuk ke game.
column2: Khi bật, nhấn PLAY trên instance Rust sẽ mở giao diện bên trong của Horizon trước thay vì vào thẳng game.

column1: Otomatis menerima pembaruan versi Minecraft {0} secara real-time.
column2: Tự động nhận cập nhật phiên bản Minecraft {0} theo thời gian thực.

column1: # Log game: simpan otomatis dan bagikan
Setiap keluar dari Minecraft, log sesi itu disimpan otomatis (10 terakhir), tanpa token akun. Bila ada masalah, misalnya shader tidak termuat, bagikan log terbaru ke pengembang.
column2: M\u1ed7i l\u1ea7n tho\u00e1t Minecraft, nh\u1eadt k\u00fd c\u1ee7a phi\u00ean \u0111\u00f3 \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c t\u1ef1 \u0111\u1ed9ng l\u01b0u (10 b\u1ea3n g\u1ea7n nh\u1ea5t), kh\u00f4ng ch\u1ee9a token t\u00e0i kho\u1ea3n. N\u1ebfu c\u00f3 s\u1ef1 c\u1ed1, v\u00ed d\u1ee5 shader kh\u00f4ng t\u1ea3i \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c, h\u00e3y chia s\u1ebb nh\u1eadt k\u00fd m\u1edbi nh\u1ea5t cho nh\u00e0 ph\u00e1t tri\u1ec3n.

column2: Ch\u01b0a c\u00f3 nh\u1eadt k\u00fd. H\u00e3y ch\u01a1i game m\u1ed9t l\u1ea7n r\u1ed3i tho\u00e1t; nh\u1eadt k\u00fd s\u1ebd t\u1ef1 \u0111\u1ed9ng \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c l\u01b0u.

column1: Tidak perlu dinyalakan atau diatur. Colok controller (gamepad) lalu main: stick kiri jalan, stick kanan kamera, A lompat, RT pukul, LT pasang, Y inventaris, Start = Esc. Di menu stick menggerakkan kursor. Mouse dan keyboard fisik juga langsung bisa dipakai. Tombol layar tersembunyi sendiri saat controller atau mouse dipakai. Kecepatan stick mengikuti sensitivitas kamera dan kursor di atas. Bila mod controller (mis. Controlify) terdeteksi, controller langsung diserahkan ke mod.
column2: Không cần bật hay cài đặt gì. Cắm tay cầm (gamepad) rồi chơi: cần trái để đi, cần phải xoay camera, A nhảy, RT đánh, LT đặt/dùng, Y mở túi đồ, Start = Esc. Trong menu, cần gạt di chuyển con trỏ. Chuột và bàn phím vật lý cũng dùng được ngay. Nút trên màn hình tự ẩn khi dùng tay cầm hoặc chuột. Tốc độ cần gạt theo độ nhạy camera và con trỏ ở trên. Nếu phát hiện mod tay cầm (ví dụ Controlify), tay cầm được giao thẳng cho mod.
